card.name: 'as' and 'on' in dosing phrases
card.fires_on: The small words "as" and "on" inside set dosing phrases, such as "as needed", "as part of a regimen" and "titrate based on clinical response".

modes.label: as needed / as part of
modes.description: The word "as" after a dosing interval or a drug list, just before "needed" or "part of".
modes.example: orally, up to the adult dose, every 3 or 4 hours<< as>> needed, and at the lowest dose necessary

modes.label: based on
modes.description: The word "on" after "titrate based", just before "clinical response".
